newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Coupons on Saudi two- to five-year bonds higher.
newsitem.headline: Coupons on Saudi two- to five-year bonds higher.

text.p: Coupons were higher at the latest issue of two- to five-year government bonds worth 1.5 billion riyals by the Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency, a banker said.
The bonds are offered every two weeks on a Saturday.

The annual coupon for two-year bonds was up at 6.43 percent from 6.21 two weeks earlier and the rate on three-year bonds rose to 6.68 from 6.44 percent. The yield on four-year bonds increased to 6.83 percent from 6.56 and the rate on five-year paper rose to 7.02 percent from 6.73.
The rates are fixed at 30 basis points above the comparable U.S. note for two years, 35 points for three years, 40 points for four years and 50 points for five years.
